name: qa-commerce-lab
description: QA Commerce Lab - realistic electronics e-commerce built as a System Under Test for QA automation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose exec api npm run db:reset:prod
